route_title: 24-Layer Periodic Quarter-Wave Stack with Verified Grid Alignment
compilation_rationale: Compiled fixed 16-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 stack per topology override. Initial thicknesses use quarter-wave estimates near 560 nm. Optimization minimizes transmittance at 355 nm, 355–365 nm, and 1030–1080 nm while maximizing it in 420–700 nm under normal-incidence unpolarized light. Coherent smatrix solver applied with gradient descent over 1000 steps.
